Title:LEMBAGA GERAKAN PELAJARAN DEWASA BILL (As reported from Select Committee)
MPs Speaking:Inche Yaacob Bin Mohamed (Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development); Mr Yong Nyuk Lin (Minister for Education); Mr Thio Chan Bee; Sir George Oehlers (Mr Speaker);


Column: 494

LEMBAGA GERAKAN PELAJARAN DEWASA BILL
(As reported from Select Committee)


    Mr Thio Chan Bee: Sir, if it is important that at the present stage nominees from the Universities must be nominated by the Government and not by the Universities, I think there is no purpose in putting down here that one member to be appointed by the Minister should be among the tutorial staff of the University of Malaya in Singapore, and another member to be appointed by the Minister from among the tutorial staff of Nanyang University in Singapore. We may as well have it clearly stated that two members would be appointed by the Minister from the educational bodies. That would cover the same point. But the moment the Universities are mentioned, naturally one would expect that they would be accorded the right to nominate their own representatives. That is natural and logical.

    Amendment negatived.
